evals.prompt: I need to add an FAQ page to our Shopify store and publish a blog post announcing our summer sale. We already have an Admin API token set up.
evals.expected_output: Use of the GraphQL Admin API (pageCreate / articleCreate) with SEO fields and semantic HTML, plus a verification query and admin/live URLs.
expectations: Uses the GraphQL Admin API (pageCreate / articleCreate) rather than legacy REST endpoints
Includes SEO title/description fields on the created content
Uses semantic HTML in the page/article body (h2-h6, p, ul/ol) without inline styles
Verifies the created content with a follow-up query and gives the admin/live URLs
